INTRODUCING OUR NEW BREAKING WORKSHOP: HAPPENING ‼️‼️THIS SATURDAY‼️‼️

#breaking #hiphop #seattle #workshop #community

“Deathray is a bboy from Tokyo and Seattle, representing Rumble Kingz and Speak Low. With 12 years of experience as a bboy and 16 years as a dancer, he is dedicated to the growth and preservation of hip-hop culture. His approach to breaking is rooted in the foundations, history, and continued evolution of the culture.” 
@rmk.deathray

“Hocine is a native of Nantes (France) with Tunisian roots. He embarked on his Breaking journey in 1997 under the mentorship of French Hip Hop trailblazers HB2, namely Yasmin and Aziz. He then co-founded KLP Krew alongside his brother and childhood companions. In 2008, he joined Massive Monkees, eventually relocating to Seattle in 2010. Since then, he has had the opportunity to battle and perform around the globe, always staying committed to passing down his experiences to the community. He continues to teach the youth at The Beacon, battle and perform alongside the new generation of Massive Monkees, and produce Massive Monkees Day.” 
@hocine_mm

“Run has been breaking for over a decade and battled across the world. Representing Renegade Rockers Crew” 
@run.ilc

“Walle Brown is a dancer, teacher, and innovator from Atlanta, Georgia, known for his love of breaking, house, and conditioning.  Since 2010, He has dedicated himself to the art of breaking, training through self-practice, guided mentorship, and regular attendance of workshops. He has been featured in music videos, won competitions, and has taught across several studios. His passion for dance has led him to travel the globe.

We will be using an app to record the infrastructure accessibility of a section of the neighborhood. It’ll be a weekend filled with learning from the Word, worship, prayer, deep and meaningful conversations, bonding with the community, and fun activities and games!

Please take note of all this very important information‼️

Time:
January 8-10, 2027 (Arriving Friday evening and returning Sunday afternoon)

Location:
Lake Retreat Camps

Price:
$150 for early bird (by 11/18 at 11:59pm)
$170 for regular (11/19-12/9)

To complete registration, you must submit all 4 of these items (link in bio):
1. Google Form Registration
2. Signed AACF Waiver
3. Signed Lake Retreat Waiver
4. Payment (via AACF form)

ALL payment and forms are due by December 9, 2026‼️

If finances/money is a concern, we offer scholarships! Read the details in the Google Form or reach out to a core member. We don’t want finances to be an issue for attending retreat with us!
